newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Polar rises 17.39 pct in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Polar rises 17.39 pct in late trade.

text.p: Polar Mines and Development Corp rose by one centavo, or 17.39 percent, to 6.75 centavos in late trade on talks the company will venture into real estate development, brokers said.
"There is talk that Polar may enter into a real estate venture with an existing property company," said one broker who asked not to be named.
Polar officials were not immediately available for comment.
Last year, Polar shares rose on speculation the company will be converted into a real estate firm, but the Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) said that the company is still listed as a mining firm.
Polar reached a record high of seven centavos in late trade but quickly dipped to 6.75 centavos. Some 603,000 Polar shares changed hands in late trade.
